summary: open <slug> [--obsidian] | edit | new <type> <name> | backlinks | stale | orphans | canvas <hub|#tag> | list
hints: Navigate/grow the wiki: open/edit/new/backlinks/stale/orphans/canvas/list. `open --obsidian` (or OPS_OPEN=obsidian) opens the note in Obsidian via a local obsidian:// URI. `canvas <hub|#tag>` writes a deterministic wiki/canvas/<slug>.canvas (JSON Canvas). Common mistake: a duplicate slug on `new` — slugs are unique.
